A FEW HELPFUL DETAILS

Before we begin.

Can the theme and colours be customised?

Share your references and preferred colours with us. We’ll discuss the design possibilities for your venue and agreed scope.

How much does this celebration cost?

Pricing depends on the venue, guest count, styling and coordination required. Request a personalised quote on WhatsApp.

How do I check availability?

Send your event type, preferred date and location through the enquiry form. Our team will discuss availability directly with you.
